finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Inconsistent/duplicated intent ID values across start vs complete steps (start captures same idp_intent_id for A and B, while complete returns different IDs) indicates possible capture/mapping bug or server-side confusion in intent identifiers.

finding.description: [LLM-Judge] Scope escalation via RFC8693 token exchange: despite failing to obtain a minimal-scope token, the exchange succeeded and produced a token with expanded scopes/claims (email/profile/metadata), indicating missing downscoping enforcement/binding to upstream authorization.

sequence.description: Token exchange should not allow scope escalation: obtain a minimal-scope access token via OIDC code flow, then attempt RFC8693 token_exchange requesting expanded scopes; verify exchanged token does not gain extra scopes/claims beyond upstream intent.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions (scopes/claims) in an exchanged token must not exceed the upstream authorization intent (original granted scopes) intersected with broker policy; token_exchange must not be a scope escalation vector.
